query: Периодически выбирай новые записи из PostgreSQL public.orders и сохраняй их в JSON-файл /data/output/orders_export.json.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: orders_json_export
  name: Orders to JSON Export
  description: Periodically export new records from PostgreSQL orders table to JSON
    file
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: '{{SCHEDULE_INTERVAL}}'
sources:
- id: source_orders
  name: Read Orders from PostgreSQL
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: public.orders
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{DB_HOST}}'
      port: '{{DB_PORT}}'
      database: '{{DATABASE_NAME}}'
      username: '{{DB_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{DB_PASSWORD}}'
processing_elements:
- id: process_export
  name: Export to JSON
  operation: Export
  config:
    output_path: /data/output/orders_export.json
    mode: append
sinks:
- id: sink_json
  name: Write to JSON File
  type: File
  location: /data/output/orders_export.json
processed_data:
- id: orders_json
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_orders
  to_id: process_export
  data_ref: orders_json
- from_id: process_export
  to_id: sink_json
  data_ref: orders_json

error.details: JSON parse error: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
